tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Search locally supplied Queenstown, Milford Sound, Wanaka and Te Anau experiences by destination, category, maximum price (NZD), and minimum rating. Returns locally supplied details only.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Get full details for one experience by its slug: description, highlights, inclusions, price, rating, and cancellation.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the four Queenstown Tourism destinations with a description and bookable-experience count.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Find locally supplied Queenstown and Milford Sound itinerary records by free-text query and duration.

tools.name: travel_faq
tools.description: Answer a Queenstown, Milford Sound, Wanaka or Te Anau travel question from published guides. Returns quoted guide text with its source page, or says plainly that no guide covers it. Not live information.

tools.name: today_news
tools.description: Read currently eligible reports from the same accepted news release as the website, with original publication/source dates, citations and revision identity. Historical articles remain in the archive. No live road or ski status.

tools.name: today_fact
tools.description: Get a locally supplied verified fact about Queenstown, Fiordland, or the Southern Lakes with its recorded basis.

tools.name: live_conditions
tools.description: Find the Queenstown weather reader and source timestamps, plus official travel and resort report links. Does not return current condition claims from bundled data. Road and ski status widgets are retired.

tools.name: find_places_to_eat
tools.description: Find published places to eat and drink in Queenstown, Wanaka, Arrowtown and Te Anau by area, type, price band, name or cuisine text, and whether they are open now (New Zealand time). Business details only, no booking.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get one published venue by slug: address, contact, hours, and menu lines with price as printed, capture date and source link. Prices change without notice.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Answer a question about a named Queenstown, Fiordland, Wanaka or Arrowtown activity, walk, route or town from reviewed facts, each with who states it, its source link and the date it was last confirmed. Says so when no reviewed fact covers it. Not live information.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: List every reviewed fact we hold on one activity, walk, route, place or facility, grouped by topic, each with its source and the date it was last confirmed.

tools.name: check_requirements
tools.description: List the published age, height, weight, health and safety rules for one activity or track, with sources. Lists rules only: it never decides whether a person can take part, and a rule not listed may still exist.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: List reviewed facts on getting between two places in the Southern Lakes and Fiordland: distances, drive times and services, each with its source. Not live road or timetable information.

tools.name: compare_options
tools.description: Set the reviewed facts on two activities, walks or places side by side, with sources. Offers no ranking or verdict.
